text:
ops-bot: ALERT: spike in apiserver 5xx rate in us-west2, paging eng-sre
anya: apiserver shows a burst of proposal timeouts against etcd leader, clients seeing DeadlineExceeded
lee: kube-controller-manager crashed on two control-plane nodes, logs include "etcdserver: request timed out" and many retry loops
neteng: telemetry: NAT ephemeral utilization at 0.96 and SYN retransmits spiking around 11:42 UTC
anya: timeline: autoscaler created ~60 GPU nodes for onboarding, onboarding controller launched parallel image pulls (high fanout)
platform: registry mirror had intermittent 503s -> clients retried aggressively, amplifying connections
sre-oncall: mitigation: cordon newest GPU nodes and pause onboarding jobs; executing cordon now
lee: executed `kubectl cordon gpu-onboard-*` and scaled down autoscaler by 40%
neteng: cloud case opened to increase ephemeral pool and add standby NAT gateway (case CLD-42421) ETA ~35m
anya: after cordon apiserver 5xx dropped from 22% -> 5% in ~90s, etcd proposal latency p95 back to ~120ms
platform: temporary tweak: set onboarding webhook to limit parallel pulls to 8 and add exponential backoff for registry retries
neteng: long-term: add SNAT autoscaling, add alert at 0.75 utilization, and distribute LB healthchecks across NATs to avoid single gw hot spots
sre-oncall: filed SRE-2025-1955 for followups and remediation tasks: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-2025-1955
anya: preliminary root cause: onboarding fanout + registry retry storms -> SNAT exhaustion -> asymmetric TCP resets to etcd followers -> proposal timeouts -> apiserver 5xx + controller-manager churn
platform: will PR pull-cap and retry backoff changes with rollback plan by EOD
anya: please add chaos test for egress saturation during heavy onboarding in next sprint. keep posting cloud ticket updates here. :thumbsup:
